items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Edith Curry sang in front of that band, and she directed the band.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, that's why! That's what it is. Like, today in most of the major cities in Europe, you don't actually get television shows until around about five in the evening -- five o'clock. And the rest, you get records played on the television!

But the radio was the big thing, radio and records -- the 78's, you know. I heard lots of, lots of great things go down, and I heard lots of great players when I would go out of town with the band during the summer. I remember an alto saxophone player named Lips(?) Rose; he was down in Alexandria, Louisiana -- great saxophone player. And his wife's name was Edith Kirk(?) They would work with a band called Little Joe. And she was a fantastic singer, had been opera-trained and everything, had a great presentation…
